Use the four accepted presentation scenes as the four greeting images under the external Hello! caption; do not commission a redundant greeting collage.
Every master and crop must be mapped to at least one named lesson component.
required_output: One closed JSON object following visual-plan-stage.template.json and copying required_input_bindings exactly.
